functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_rendimiento_list(p_worker uuid, p_filters jsonb, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workers WHERE id=p_worker AND is_active IS DISTINCT FROM false AND role::text IN ('admin','central'))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acceso no autorizado.' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 p_size:=least(100,greatest(20,coalesce(p_size,50)));p_page:=greatest(1,coalesce(p_page,1));
 WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.* FROM public.rendimiento_llamadas r
 WHERE (coalesce(p_filters->>'from','')='' OR r.fecha_hora >= (nullif(p_filters->>'from','')||'T00:00:00Z')::timestamptz)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'to','')='' OR r.fecha_hora < (nullif(p_filters->>'to','')||'T00:00:00Z')::timestamptz+interval '1 day')
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'cliente','')='' OR position(public.tc_rendimiento_text(p_filters->>'cliente') in public.tc_rendimiento_text(r.cliente_nombre))>0)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'telefonista','')='' OR position(public.tc_rendimiento_text(p_filters->>'telefonista') in public.tc_rendimiento_text(r.telefonista_nombre))>0)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'tarotista','')='' OR position(public.tc_rendimiento_text(p_filters->>'tarotista') in public.tc_rendimiento_text(concat_ws(' ',r.tarotista_nombre,r.tarotista_manual_call)))>0)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'captado','')='' OR r.captado=(p_filters->>'captado')::boolean)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'promo','')='' OR r.promo=(p_filters->>'promo')::boolean)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'call','')='' OR r.llamada_call=(p_filters->>'call')::boolean)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'importe','all')<>'positive' OR r.importe>0)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'importe','all')<>'zero' OR coalesce(r.importe,0)=0)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.crm_clientes c WHERE c.id::text=btrim(r.cliente_id) AND lower(coalesce(c.origen,'')) LIKE '%orion%')
 ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM base WHERE
 (coalesce(p_filters->>'codigo','')='' OR position(public.tc_rendimiento_text(p_filters->>'codigo') in public.tc_rendimiento_text(concat_ws(' ',resumen_codigo,codigo_1,codigo_2,tipo_registro)))>0)
 AND (coalesce(p_filters->>'metodo','')='' OR public.tc_rendimiento_text(forma_pago)=public.tc_rendimiento_text(p_filters->>'metodo'))
 ), stats AS (SELECT count(*) total,coalesce(sum(tiempo),0) minutes,coalesce(sum(importe),0) amount,count(*) FILTER(WHERE captado) captured FROM filtered),
 page_rows AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY fecha_hora DESC,id DESC LIMIT p_size OFFSET (p_page-1)::bigint*p_size),
 checked AS (SELECT r.*,public.tc_rendimiento_edit_reason(r::public.rendimiento_llamadas,p_worker) edit_reason FROM page_rows r)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'data',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)||jsonb_build_object('can_edit',r.edit_reason IS NULL,'can_delete',
 (SELECT role::text='admin' OR r.telefonista_worker_id=p_worker::text FROM public.workers WHERE id=p_worker)) ORDER BY r.fecha_hora DESC,r.id DESC) FROM checked r),'[]'::jsonb),
 'totals',jsonb_build_object('records',s.total,'minutes',round(s.minutes,2),'amount',round(s.amount,2),'captured',s.captured),
 'pagination',jsonb_build_object('page',p_page,'page_size',p_size,'total',s.total,'pages',greatest(1,ceil(s.total::numeric/p_size))),
 'payment_methods',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('value',value,'label',label) ORDER BY label) FROM
 (SELECT public.tc_rendimiento_text(forma_pago) value,min(btrim(forma_pago)) label FROM base
 WHERE btrim(coalesce(forma_pago,''))<>'' GROUP BY public.tc_rendimiento_text(forma_pago)) m),'[]'::jsonb))
 INTO result FROM stats s;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tc_raffle_state(p_raffle uuid, p_worker uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r public.raffles; w public.workers; result jsonb;
begin
 select * into w from public.workers where id=p_worker and role in ('central','admin') and is_active is not false;
 if not found then raise exception 'Sin permiso' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 select * into r from public.raffles where id=p_raffle and status='active';
 if not found then raise exception 'El sorteo ya no está activo' using errcode='P0001'; end if;
 if (select count(*) from public.raffle_entries where raffle_id=r.id)>10000 then
   raise exception 'El sorteo supera 10000 participaciones; no se cargará una lista parcial'; end if;
 select jsonb_build_object(
   'raffle',jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'title',r.title,'allow_repeat_winners',r.allow_repeat_winners),
   'canManage',w.role='admin',
   'canSelect',w.role in ('central','admin'),
   'entries',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'id',e.id,'number',e.raffle_number,'clientId',e.client_id,
     'name',coalesce(nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',c.nombre,c.apellido)),''),'Cliente sin nombre'),
     'phone',case when w.role='admin' then coalesce(c.telefono_normalizado,c.telefono,'') else null end,
     'won',exists(select 1 from public.raffle_prizes p where p.raffle_id=r.id and p.confirmed_at is not null and p.candidate_client_id=e.client_id),
     'eligible',r.allow_repeat_winners or not exists(select 1 from public.raffle_prizes p where p.raffle_id=r.id and p.confirmed_at is not null and p.candidate_client_id=e.client_id)
   ) order by e.raffle_number) from public.raffle_entries e join public.crm_clientes c on c.id=e.client_id where e.raffle_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),
   'prizes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) || jsonb_build_object(
     'candidate_name',nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ',c.nombre,c.apellido)),''),
     'selected_by_name',s.display_name,'confirmed_by_name',f.display_name
   ) order by p.position) from public.raffle_prizes p
     left join public.crm_clientes c on c.id=p.candidate_client_id
     left join public.workers s on s.id=p.selected_by left join public.workers f on f.id=p.confirmed_by
     where p.raffle_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),
   'audit',case when w.role='admin' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) from
      (select l.id,l.action_type,l.payload,l.created_at,wk.display_name as actor
       from public.raffle_selection_audit l left join public.workers wk on wk.id=l.worker_id
       where l.entity_type='raffle_selection' and l.entity_id=r.id order by l.created_at desc limit 100) a),'[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end
 ) into result;
 return result;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_worker_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$

  from public.workers w
  where w.user_id = (select auth.uid())
     or w.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
  order by case when w.user_id = (select auth.uid()) then 0 else 1 end
  limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.staff_chat_latest_incoming(p_worker_id uuid, p_thread_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, thread_id uuid, sender_worker_id uuid, sender_display_name text, text text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select distinct on (m.thread_id) m.id,m.thread_id,m.sender_worker_id,
    coalesce(m.sender_display_name,''),m.body,m.created_at
  from public.chat_messages m
  join public.chat_threads t on t.id=m.thread_id
  join public.workers w on w.id=p_worker_id and w.is_active
    and w.role in ('admin','central','tarotista')
  where m.thread_id=any(p_thread_ids) and m.sender_worker_id<>p_worker_id
    and (w.role='admin' or w.id=t.central_worker_id or w.id=t.tarotist_worker_id)
  order by m.thread_id,m.created_at desc,m.id desc;
$function$
